verses.sloka: स तत् अन्तः पुर द्वारम् समतीत्य जन आकुलम् ।प्रविविक्ताम् ततः कक्ष्याम् आससाद पुराणवित् ॥२-१६-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa tat antaḥ pura dvāram samatītya jana ākulam ।praviviktām tataḥ kakṣyām āsasāda purāṇavit ॥2-16-1॥

translations.english: Sumantra, who was conversant with ancient traditions, passed through the entrance of the inner apartment full of people and reached the sparsely crowded courtyard. There alert, loyal young men were attentively guarding the frontyard, armed with spears and bows and wearing shining earrings.

verses.sloka: प्रास कार्मुक बिभ्रद्भिर् युवभिर् मृष्ट कुण्डलैः ।अप्रमादिभिर् एक अग्रैः स्वनुरक्तैः अधिष्ठिताम् ॥२-१६-२॥
verses.transliteration: prāsa kārmuka bibhradbhir yuvabhir mṛṣṭa kuṇḍalaiḥ ।apramādibhir eka agraiḥ svanuraktaiḥ adhiṣṭhitām ॥2-16-2॥

translations.english: Sumantra, who was conversant with ancient traditions, passed through the entrance of the inner apartment full of people and reached the sparsely crowded courtyard. There alert, loyal young men were attentively guarding the frontyard, armed with spears and bows and wearing shining earrings.
translations.hindi: उन्होंने जाते ही पहले बड़े विनीतभाव से पिता के चरणों में माथा नवाया और फिर माता कैकेयी को बड़ी प्रणाम किया

verses.sloka: तत्र काषायिणो वृद्धान् वेत्र पाणीन् स्वलम्कृतान् ।ददर्श विष्ठितान् द्वारि स्त्र्य् अध्यक्षान् सुसमाहितान् ॥२-१६-३॥
verses.transliteration: tatra kāṣāyiṇo vṛddhān vetra pāṇīn svalamkṛtān ।dadarśa viṣṭhitān dvāri stry adhyakṣān susamāhitān ॥2-16-3॥

translations.english: He saw aged people appointed as security staff for women's apartments. They were welladorned, dressed in orange robes and with rapt attention stood holding staff in their hands.
translations.hindi: श्रीरामचन्द्र को देख महाराज दशरथ केबल “राम” ही कह सके । क्योंकि फिर दुःखी महाराज के नेत्रों से अश्रधारा बहने लगी और उनका कण्ठ गद्गद्‌ हो गया । फिर वे न तो कुछ देख ही सके ओर न कुछ बोल ही सके

verses.sloka: ते समीक्ष्य समायान्तम् राम प्रिय चिकीर्षवः ।सह भार्याय रामाय क्षिप्रम् एव आचचक्षिरे ॥२-१६-४॥
verses.transliteration: te samīkṣya samāyāntam rāma priya cikīrṣavaḥ ।saha bhāryāya rāmāya kṣipram eva ācacakṣire ॥2-16-4॥

translations.english: On seeing (Sumantra) arriving, all of them, wellwishers to Rama, quickly rose from their seats.
translations.hindi: जिस प्रकार सर्प को पैर से छूने पर मन में अय का संचार जाता है, उसी प्रकार पिता की भयावह दशा देख, श्रीरामचन्द्र | जी के मन में भय का संचार हुआ

verses.sloka: प्रतिवेदितम् आज्ञाय सूतम् अभ्यन्तरम् पितुः ।तत्र एव आनाययाम् आस राघवः प्रिय काम्यया ॥२-१६-५॥
verses.transliteration: prativeditam ājñāya sūtam abhyantaram pituḥ ।tatra eva ānāyayām āsa rāghavaḥ priya kāmyayā ॥2-16-5॥

translations.english: . Humble and extremely courteous charioteer (to the guards) said, Inform Rama at once that Sumantra is waiting at the entrance.
translations.hindi: उस समय महाराज की इन्द्रियाँ विकल थीं, वे शोक, | लि उखु बे ७ व '> सन्ताप से झ्लेशित हो रहे थे और मानसिक विकलता और विथा ... के कारण बारंबार दीचे निःश्वास छोड़ रहे थे

verses.sloka: ते राममुपसम्गम्य भर्तुः प्रियचिकीर्षवः ।सहभार्याय रामाय क्षिप्रमेवाचचक्षिरे ॥२-१६-६॥
verses.transliteration: te rāmamupasamgamya bhartuḥ priyacikīrṣavaḥ ।sahabhāryāya rāmāya kṣipramevācacakṣire ॥2-16-6॥

translations.english: Always dedicated to the wellbeing of their master, they approached Rama who was in the company of Sita. And informed him:
translations.hindi: प्रकृति से ही क्षोभ को न पाने बाले, किन्तु समय के फेर से लहरों से लुब्ध सागर की, राहु से ग्रस्त सूयं की, मिथ्या भाषण से ऋषि की जो दशा होती है वही दशा उस समय महाराज दशरथ की थी

verses.sloka: प्रतिवेदितमाज्ञाय सूतमभ्यम्तरम् पितुः ।तत्रैवानाययामास राघवः पियकाम्यया ॥२-१६-७॥
verses.transliteration: prativeditamājñāya sūtamabhyamtaram pituḥ ।tatraivānāyayāmāsa rāghavaḥ piyakāmyayā ॥2-16-7॥

translations.english: Coming to know that Sumantra who is intimate to his father had arrived, Rama, in order to please him, commanded that he be escorted to that very place.
translations.hindi: अपने पिता की ऐसी असम्भावित दशा देख ओर उनके शोक का कारण न जान कर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के मन में वैसी ही खलबली मची जैसी कि पूणंमासी के दिन समुद्र में मचती है

verses.sloka: तम् वैश्रवण सम्काशम् उपविष्टम् स्वलम्कृतम् ।दादर्श सूतः पर्यन्के सौवणो स उत्तरच् चदे ॥२-१६-८॥
verses.transliteration: tam vaiśravaṇa samkāśam upaviṣṭam svalamkṛtam ।dādarśa sūtaḥ paryanke sauvaṇo sa uttarac cade ॥2-16-8॥

translations.english: Sumantra beheld Rama, who resembled Kubera. Rama was sitting on a richlycovered golden couch, welladorned and anointed with precious, pure, fragrant red sandalpaste the colour of which appeared like the blood of a hog. With Sita standing by his side with a fan of yak's tail in her hand Rama, the tormentor of foes, looked like the Moon united with (the star) Chitra.

verses.sloka: वराह रुधिर आभेण शुचिना च सुगन्धिना ।अनुलिप्तम् पर अर्ध्येन चन्दनेन परम् तपम् ॥२-१६-९॥
verses.transliteration: varāha rudhira ābheṇa śucinā ca sugandhinā ।anuliptam para ardhyena candanena param tapam ॥2-16-9॥

translations.english: Sumantra beheld Rama, who resembled Kubera. Rama was sitting on a richlycovered golden couch, welladorned and anointed with precious, pure, fragrant red sandalpaste the colour of which appeared like the blood of a hog. With Sita standing by his side with a fan of yak's tail in her hand Rama, the tormentor of foes, looked like the Moon united with (the star) Chitra.
translations.hindi: पिता की सदा भलाई चाहने वाले श्रीरामचन्द्र मन ही मन; सोचने लगे कि क्या कारण है आज पिता मुझे देख कर दुःखी हो रहे हैं और न मुझे आशीवाद देते है ॥=॥। : अन्यदा मां पिता दृष्ट्रा कुपितोऽपि प्रसीदति । ` तस्य मामद्य सम्प्रक्ष्य ।कमायासः प्रवतत

verses.sloka: स्थितया पार्श्वतः च अपि वाल व्यजन हस्तया ।उपेतम् सीतया भूयः चित्रया शशिनम् यथा ॥२-१६-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sthitayā pārśvataḥ ca api vāla vyajana hastayā ।upetam sītayā bhūyaḥ citrayā śaśinam yathā ॥2-16-10॥

translations.english: Sumantra beheld Rama, who resembled Kubera. Rama was sitting on a richlycovered golden couch, welladorned and anointed with precious, pure, fragrant red sandalpaste the colour of which appeared like the blood of a hog. With Sita standing by his side with a fan of yak's tail in her hand Rama, the tormentor of foes, looked like the Moon united with (the star) Chitra.
translations.hindi: वे क्यों दीनों को तरह शोक से आते, उदास और हीनद्यति हो रहे हैं । (इस प्रकार सोचते हुए जब वे स्वयं इसका कारण निश्चित न कर सके तब ) कैकेयी को प्रणाम कर श्रीराम चन्द्र जी बोले

verses.sloka: तम् तपन्तम् इव आदित्यम् उपपन्नम् स्व तेजसा ।ववन्दे वरदम् बन्दी नियमज्ञो विनीतवत् ॥२-१६-११॥
verses.transliteration: tam tapantam iva ādityam upapannam sva tejasā ।vavande varadam bandī niyamajño vinītavat ॥2-16-11॥

translations.english: Sumantra who knew the art of modesty, made humble, reverential salutation to Rama the granter of boons, shining like the Sun with his own effulgence.
translations.hindi: यदि मुझसे अनजाने कोई अपराध हो गया हो, जिससे कुपित हो पिता जी मुझसे नहीं बोलते तो मेरी ओर से आपही इनको प्रसन्न कर दीजिए

verses.sloka: प्रान्जलिस् तु सुखम् पृष्ट्वा विहार शयन आसने ।राज पुत्रम् उवाच इदम् सुमन्त्रः राज सत्कृतः ॥२-१६-१२॥
verses.transliteration: prānjalis tu sukham pṛṣṭvā vihāra śayana āsane ।rāja putram uvāca idam sumantraḥ rāja satkṛtaḥ ॥2-16-12॥

translations.english: On seeing Rama of charming countenance relaxing on a couch, Sumantra, honourable to the king (Dasaratha) said these words with folded palms.
translations.hindi: अप्रसन्न मन होने पर भी पिता जी की मुझ पर सदा कृपा रहती थी । किन्तु आज मैं देखता हूँ कि, उनके चेहरे का रंग उतर गया है ओर वे दीनभाब से बैठे हैं और मुझसे बोलते भी नहीं

verses.sloka: कौसल्या सुप्रभा देव पिता त्वम् द्रष्टुम् इच्चति ।महिष्या सह कैकेय्या गम्यताम् तत्र माचिरम् ॥२-१६-१३॥
verses.transliteration: kausalyā suprabhā deva pitā tvam draṣṭum iccati ।mahiṣyā saha kaikeyyā gamyatām tatra māciram ॥2-16-13॥

translations.english: O Rama, worthy son of Kausalya, your father along with queen Kaikeyi desires to see you.You may go there. Please do not delay.
translations.hindi: क्या पिता जी को कोई शारीरिक या मानसिक कष्ट तो नहीं ड कर रहा है ? क्योंकि मनुष्य का सदा सुखी रहना दर्लभ

verses.sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु सम्हृष्टः नर सिम्हो महा द्युतिः ।ततः सम्मानयाम् आस सीताम् इदम् उवाच ह ॥२-१६-१४॥
verses.transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu samhṛṣṭaḥ nara simho mahā dyutiḥ ।tataḥ sammānayām āsa sītām idam uvāca ha ॥2-16-14॥

translations.english: Highly lustrous Rama ,the lion among men, when thus spoken to, was immensely pleased and extending due honour to him said to Sita:

verses.sloka: देवि देवः च देवी च समागम्य मद् अन्तरे ।मन्त्रेयेते ध्रुवम् किम्चित् अभिषेचन सम्हितम् ॥२-१६-१५॥
verses.transliteration: devi devaḥ ca devī ca samāgamya mad antare ।mantreyete dhruvam kimcit abhiṣecana samhitam ॥2-16-15॥

translations.english: O Sita, I am sure the king and queen are discussing something relating to my consecration.
translations.hindi: महाराज का कहना न मान कर उनको असन्तुष्ट एवं कुपित कर मैं एक मुहूत भी जीना नहीं चाहता

verses.sloka: लक्षयित्वा हि अभिप्रायम् प्रिय कामा सुदक्षिणा ।सम्चोदयति राजानम् मद् अर्थम् मदिर ईक्षणा ॥२-१६-१६॥
verses.transliteration: lakṣayitvā hi abhiprāyam priya kāmā sudakṣiṇā ।samcodayati rājānam mad artham madira īkṣaṇā ॥2-16-16॥

translations.english: Darkeyed and highly favoured wellwisher of the king (Kaikeyi) is urging him for my sake in view of his intention.
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जिन पिता-माता से मनुष्य की उत्पत्ति होती है उन अत्यक्ष देवताओं को आज्ञा क्यों न मानी जाय

verses.sloka: सा प्रहृष्टा महाराजम् हितकामानुवर्तिनी ।जननी चार्थकामा मे केकयाधिपतेस्सुता ॥२-१६-१७॥
verses.transliteration: sā prahṛṣṭā mahārājam hitakāmānuvartinī ।jananī cārthakāmā me kekayādhipatessutā ॥2-16-17॥

translations.english: My mother, daughter of the king of Kekaya, knows the king's intention and, heppy to do me good, seeks my wellbeing.
translations.hindi: कहीं तुमने तो अभिमान से कोई कठोर वचन महाराज से नहीं कह दिया, जिसको सुन, क्रुद्ध होने के कारण महाराज का मन बिगड़ गया हो ?

verses.sloka: दिष्ट्या खलु महाराजो महिष्या प्रियया सह ।सुमम्त्रम् प्राहिणोद्दूत मर्थकामकरम् मम ॥२-१६-१८॥
verses.transliteration: diṣṭyā khalu mahārājo mahiṣyā priyayā saha ।sumamtram prāhiṇoddūta marthakāmakaram mama ॥2-16-18॥

translations.english: It is our fortune that the king and his dear queen have sent Sumantra as messenger who is interested in my prosperity and pleasure.
translations.hindi: हे देवि! मैं जो तुझसे पूछता हूँ उसको मुझे तू टीक-ठीक सममा कर कह। महाराज के मन में इस अपूर्वे विकार के उत्पन्न होने का क्या कारण है ?

verses.sloka: यादृशी परिषत् तत्र तादृशो दूताअगतः ।ध्रुवम् अद्य एव माम् राजा यौवराज्ये अभिषेक्ष्यति ॥२-१६-१९॥
verses.transliteration: yādṛśī pariṣat tatra tādṛśo dūtāagataḥ ।dhruvam adya eva mām rājā yauvarājye abhiṣekṣyati ॥2-16-19॥

translations.english: There worthy of the council of the king and the queen, a befitting messenger has come. Assuredly the king will consecrate me as heirapparent this very day.

verses.sloka: हन्त शीघ्रम् इतः गत्वा द्रक्ष्यामि च मही पतिः ।सह त्वम् परिवारेण सुखम् आस्स्व रमस्य च ॥२-१६-२०॥
verses.transliteration: hanta śīghram itaḥ gatvā drakṣyāmi ca mahī patiḥ ।saha tvam parivāreṇa sukham āssva ramasya ca ॥2-16-20॥

translations.english: I shall go from here immediately and see the king. Remain here happily and rejoice with your maids.
translations.hindi: हे राम! न तो राजा तुम पर अप्रसन्न हैं और न उनके शरीर में कोई पीड़ा है, किन्तु इनके मन में तुम्हारे विषय में एक बात है, जिसे यह तुम्हारे डर से कहते नहीं

verses.sloka: पति सम्मानिता सीता भर्तारम् असित ईक्षणा ।आद्वारम् अनुवव्राज मन्गलानि अभिदध्युषी ॥२-१६-२१॥
verses.transliteration: pati sammānitā sītā bhartāram asita īkṣaṇā ।ādvāram anuvavrāja mangalāni abhidadhyuṣī ॥2-16-21॥

translations.english: Reflecting over the auspicious event, the darkeyed Sita who is highly esteemed by her husband, followed him up to the entrance, (saying):
translations.hindi: तुम इनके बड़े प्यारे हो, अत: तुमसे अप्रिय बचन कहने को इनकी वाणी नहीं खुलती, पर तुमको उसके अनुसार, जिसकी इन्होंने मुझसे प्रतिज्ञा कर रखी है, काये करना उचित है

verses.sloka: राज्यम् द्विजातिभिर्जुष्टम् राजसूयाभिषेचनम् ।कर्तुमर्हति ते राजा वासवस्येव लोककृत् ॥२-१६-२२॥
verses.transliteration: rājyam dvijātibhirjuṣṭam rājasūyābhiṣecanam ।kartumarhati te rājā vāsavasyeva lokakṛt ॥2-16-22॥

translations.english: The king will bestow upon you, like the creator of the world (Brahma) bestowing on Indra, the kingdom served by brahmins who are fit to perform 'Rajasuya' sacrifice at the time of consecration.
translations.hindi: पहले ` इन्होंने आद्रपूर्वेक मुझे वर दिया था और उसके लिए अब यह गँवारों की तरह सन्ताप कर रहे हैं

verses.sloka: दीक्षितम् व्रतसम्पन्नम् वराजिनधरम् शुचिम् ।कुरङ्गपाणिम् च पश्यन्ती त्वाम् भजाम्यहम् ॥२-१६-२३॥
verses.transliteration: dīkṣitam vratasampannam varājinadharam śucim ।kuraṅgapāṇim ca paśyantī tvām bhajāmyaham ॥2-16-23॥

translations.english: I shall be delighted to see you initiated and engaged in the observance of the vow made pure, wearing excellent deerskin and carrying the horns of an antelope in your hand.
translations.hindi: tas [4 अष्टादशः सगः २१३ मैं बर दूँ गा ऐसी प्रतिज्ञा कर पीछे उसका बचाब सोचना वैसा ही है जैसा कि पानी बह जाने पर उसको रोकने के लिए बाँध बाँधना

verses.sloka: पूर्वाम् दिशम् वज्रधरो दक्षिणाम् पातु ते यमः ।वरुणः पश्चिमामाशाम् धनेशस्तूत्तराम् दिशम् ॥२-१६-२४॥
verses.transliteration: pūrvām diśam vajradharo dakṣiṇām pātu te yamaḥ ।varuṇaḥ paścimāmāśām dhaneśastūttarām diśam ॥2-16-24॥

translations.english: May Indra protect you on the east, Yama in the south, Varuna in the west and Kubera in the north.
translations.hindi: है धंधा मर HE ममूलमिदं राम विदितं च सतामपि। तत्सत्यं न त्यजेद्राजा कुपितस्त्वत्कृते यथा

verses.sloka: अथ सीतामनुज्ञाप्य कृतकौतुकमगLअः ।निश्चक्राम सुमन्त्रेण सह रामो निवेशनात् ॥२-१६-२५॥
verses.transliteration: atha sītāmanujñāpya kṛtakautukamagaLaḥ ।niścakrāma sumantreṇa saha rāmo niveśanāt ॥2-16-25॥

translations.english: Adorned in auspicious ornaments, Rama took leave of Sita and departed from his palace accompanied by Sumantra.

verses.sloka: पर्वतादिव निष्क्रम्य सिम्हो गिरिगुहाशयः ।लक्ष्मणम् द्वारिसोऽपश्यत् प्रह्वञ्जलिपुटम् स्थितम् ॥२-१६-२६॥
verses.transliteration: parvatādiva niṣkramya simho giriguhāśayaḥ ।lakṣmaṇam dvāriso'paśyat prahvañjalipuṭam sthitam ॥2-16-26॥

translations.english: Like a lion living in a mountain cave and coming out of it, Rama while exiting, saw Lakshmana at the entrance bowing with folded hands.
translations.hindi: अथवा यदि महाराज तुमसे स्त्रयं न कहें तो मैं इनकी ओर से जो कुछ कहूँ उसे तुम मावो, तो में कहने को तैयार हूँ, क्योंकि ये तो तुमसे न कहेंगे

verses.sloka: अथ मध्यमकक्ष्यायाम् समागच्छत् सुहृज्जनैः ।स सर्वान् अर्थिनो दृष्ट्वा समेत्य प्रतिनन्द्य च ॥२-१६-२७॥
verses.transliteration: atha madhyamakakṣyāyām samāgacchat suhṛjjanaiḥ ।sa sarvān arthino dṛṣṭvā sametya pratinandya ca ॥2-16-27॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, met all his friends in the middle courtyard. Having seen them all eager to see him, he approached and greeted them. Thereafter, he mounted the best silver chariot covered with tigerskin and glowing like fire.
translations.hindi: जब इस प्रकार केकेयी ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी से कहा तब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी अत्यन्त व्यथित हो महाराज के. पास बैठी हुई कैकेयी से बोले

verses.sloka: ततः पावक सम्काशम् आरुरोह रथ उत्तमम् ।वैयाघ्रम् पुरुष्व्या घो राजितम् राजनम्दनः ॥२-१६-२८॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ pāvaka samkāśam āruroha ratha uttamam ।vaiyāghram puruṣvyā gho rājitam rājanamdanaḥ ॥2-16-28॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, met all his friends in the middle courtyard. Having seen them all eager to see him, he approached and greeted them. Thereafter, he mounted the best silver chariot covered with tigerskin and glowing like fire.
translations.hindi: हा ! धिक्कार है! हे देवि! तुमको ऐसी बात कहनी उचित नहीं। मैं महाराज के कहने से और कामों की तो कोई वात ही नहीं, अग्नि में गिरने को तैयार हूँ

verses.sloka: मेघनादमसम्बाधम् मणिहेमविभूशितम् ।मुष्णन्तम् इव चक्षूम्षि प्रभया हेम वर्चसम् ॥२-१६-२९॥
verses.transliteration: meghanādamasambādham maṇihemavibhūśitam ।muṣṇantam iva cakṣūmṣi prabhayā hema varcasam ॥2-16-29॥

translations.english: The sound emanating from the chariot resembled the thunder. The spacious chariot was decorated with gold and gems which dazzled the eyes as though they shed the lustre of the Sun. The swiftmoving chariot was harnessed by excellent horses as if they were young elephants. Like the thousandeyed Indra, Rama, ablaze with royal splendour, mounted this chariot and sped away.

verses.sloka: करेणु शिशु कल्पैः च युक्तम् परम वाजिभिः ।हरि युक्तम् सहस्र अक्षो रथम् इन्द्रैव आशुगम् ॥२-१६-३०॥
verses.transliteration: kareṇu śiśu kalpaiḥ ca yuktam parama vājibhiḥ ।hari yuktam sahasra akṣo ratham indraiva āśugam ॥2-16-30॥

translations.english: The sound emanating from the chariot resembled the thunder. The spacious chariot was decorated with gold and gems which dazzled the eyes as though they shed the lustre of the Sun. The swiftmoving chariot was harnessed by excellent horses as if they were young elephants. Like the thousandeyed Indra, Rama, ablaze with royal splendour, mounted this chariot and sped away.
translations.hindi: अतएब हे देबि ! जो कुछ महाराज की इच्छा हो सो तू मुझ से कह्‌। मैं प्रतिज्ञा करता हूँ कि मैं उनकी आज्ञा का पालन करूँगा । माता | यह सदा याद रख कि राम दो प्रकार की बाते कहना नहीं जानता। अथवा राम जो कहता है बही करता है

verses.sloka: प्रययौ तूर्णम् आस्थाय राघवो ज्वलितः श्रिया ।स पर्जन्यैव आकाशे स्वनवान् अभिनादयन् ॥२-१६-३१॥
verses.transliteration: prayayau tūrṇam āsthāya rāghavo jvalitaḥ śriyā ।sa parjanyaiva ākāśe svanavān abhinādayan ॥2-16-31॥

translations.english: The magnificent chariot, rumbling like a stormcloud in the sky, emerged from (Rama's) residence like the Moon peeping through a huge cloud.
translations.hindi: जब सत्यवादी श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने ऐसे विनययुक्त बचन कहे, तब सकेश्रेष्ठा कैकेयी ये अत्यन्त कठोर बचन बोलो

verses.sloka: निकेतान् निर्ययौ श्रीमान् महा अभ्रात् इव चन्द्रमाः ।चत्र चामर पाणिस् तु लक्ष्मणो राघव अनुजः ॥२-१६-३२॥
verses.transliteration: niketān niryayau śrīmān mahā abhrāt iva candramāḥ ।catra cāmara pāṇis tu lakṣmaṇo rāghava anujaḥ ॥2-16-32॥

translations.english: Holding an umbrella and a fan made of yak's tail in his hand Lakshmana boarded the chariot at the rear, guarding his brother.
translations.hindi: अनाया--सवश्रेष्ठा । ( शि० ) हे रामचन्द्र ! पूवेकाल में जब देवताओं और असुरों में युद्ध हुआ था, तब उसमें महाराज बाण के लगने से घायल हुए थे । उस समय मैंने इनकीं रक्षा की थी । तब इन्होंने मुझे दो वर दिए थे

verses.sloka: जुगोप भ्रातरम् भ्राता रथम् आस्थाय पृष्ठतः ।ततः हल हला शब्दः तुमुलः समजायत ॥२-१६-३३॥
verses.transliteration: jugopa bhrātaram bhrātā ratham āsthāya pṛṣṭhataḥ ।tataḥ hala halā śabdaḥ tumulaḥ samajāyata ॥2-16-33॥

translations.english: As it (the chariot) was passing out, a tumultuoas roar emanated from the multitude of people all around.
translations.hindi: उन दो में से, आज मैंने एक से तो भरत का राज्याभिषेक और दूसरे से आज ही तुम्हारा दण्डकारण्य बन में जाना माँगा है

verses.sloka: तस्य निष्क्रममाणस्य जन ओघस्य समन्ततः ।ततो हयवरा मुख्या नागाश्च गिरिसन्निभाः ॥२-१६-३४॥
verses.transliteration: tasya niṣkramamāṇasya jana oghasya samantataḥ ।tato hayavarā mukhyā nāgāśca girisannibhāḥ ॥2-16-34॥

translations.english: Then the chief commanders riding the best of the horses and elephants, resembling hills in size, followed Rama in their hundreds and thousands.
translations.hindi: हे नरश्रेष्ठ ! यदि तुम अपने पिता को ओर अपने आपको सत्यप्रतिज्ञ बनाए रखना चाहते हो तो मैं जो कहुँ उसे सुनो

verses.sloka: अनुजग्मुस्तदा रामम् शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः ।अग्रतश्चास्य सन्नद्धाश्चन्दनागुरुभूषिताः ॥२-१६-३५॥
verses.transliteration: anujagmustadā rāmam śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ ।agrataścāsya sannaddhāścandanāgurubhūṣitāḥ ॥2-16-35॥

translations.english: Soldiers, anointing their bodies with pastes of sandal and aloe wood, equipped with armour and holding swords and bows, went ahead heralding his (Rama's) arrival.
translations.hindi: तुम्हारे पिता ने जो कुछ कहा है उसको मान कर तुम चौदह वषं के लिए बन को चले जाओ

verses.sloka: खड्गचापधराः शूरा जग्मुराशम्सवो जनाः ।ततो वादित्रशब्दाश्च स्तुतिशब्दाश्च वन्दिनाम् ॥२-१६-३६॥
verses.transliteration: khaḍgacāpadharāḥ śūrā jagmurāśamsavo janāḥ ।tato vāditraśabdāśca stutiśabdāśca vandinām ॥2-16-36॥

translations.english: At that time, sounds of musical instruments and songs of eulogy by panegyrists, roarings of warriors were heard on the way.
translations.hindi: आर महाराज ने तुम्हारे अभिषेक के लिए जो यह समस्त सामग्री एकत्र की है, उससे भरत का राज्याभिषेक हो

verses.sloka: सिम्हनादाश्च शूराणाम् तदा शुश्रुविरे पथि ।हर्म्यवातायनस्थाभिर्भूषिताभिः समन्ततः ॥२-१६-३७॥
verses.transliteration: simhanādāśca śūrāṇām tadā śuśruvire pathi ।harmyavātāyanasthābhirbhūṣitābhiḥ samantataḥ ॥2-16-37॥

translations.english: Rama, the subduer of enemies, proceeded while the wellattired women standing at the windows of their mansions showered heaps of flowers on him from every side.

verses.sloka: कीर्यमाणः सुपुष्पौघैर्ययौ स्त्रीभिररिम्दमः ।रामम् सर्वानवद्याण्ग्यो रामपिप्रीषया ततः ॥२-१६-३८॥
verses.transliteration: kīryamāṇaḥ supuṣpaughairyayau strībhirarimdamaḥ ।rāmam sarvānavadyāṇgyo rāmapiprīṣayā tataḥ ॥2-16-38॥

translations.english: Women with faultless limbs standing on their housetops as well as on the ground paid their homage with charming words in order to propitiate Rama.
translations.hindi: ओर भरत जी कोसलपुर में रह कर इस प्रथ्वी का, जो नाना रत्नों से ओर हाथी घोड़ों से परिपूर्ण है, शासन करें

verses.sloka: वचोभिरग्र्यैर्हर्म्यस्थाः क्षितिस्थाश्च ववन्दिरे ।नूनम् नन्धिति ते माता कौसल्या मातृनन्दन ॥२-१६-३९॥
verses.transliteration: vacobhiragryairharmyasthāḥ kṣitisthāśca vavandire ।nūnam nandhiti te mātā kausalyā mātṛnandana ॥2-16-39॥

translations.english: O Joy of your mother (Rama) on seeing you having successfully acomplished the purpose of your journey (life) by securing your father's kingdom, your mother Kausalya will surely be delighted.

verses.sloka: पश्यन्ती सिद्धयात्रम् त्वाम् पित्र्यम् राज्यमुपस्थितम् ।सर्वसीमन्तिनीभ्यश्च सीताम् सीमन्तिनीम् वराम् ॥२-१६-४०॥
verses.transliteration: paśyantī siddhayātram tvām pitryam rājyamupasthitam ।sarvasīmantinībhyaśca sītām sīmantinīm varām ॥2-16-40॥

translations.english: Those women considered Sita who was dear to the heart of Rama the best among all women.

verses.sloka: अमन्यन्त हि ता नार्यो रामस्य हृदयप्रियाम् ।तया सुचरितम् देव्या पुरा नूनम् महत्तपः ॥२-१६-४१॥
verses.transliteration: amanyanta hi tā nāryo rāmasya hṛdayapriyām ।tayā sucaritam devyā purā nūnam mahattapaḥ ॥2-16-41॥

translations.english: Sita was united with Rama like Rohini with the Moon surely because of her great austerities performed in the past. (They observed).
translations.hindi: पहले ही महादुःखी थे) पुत्र के भाबी कष्टों का. बिचार कर उत्तः सन्तप्त हुए

verses.sloka: रोहिणीव शशाङ्केन रामसम्योगमाप या ।इति प्रासादशृङ्गेषु प्रमदाभिर्नरोत्तमः ॥२-१६-४२॥
verses.transliteration: rohiṇīva śaśāṅkena rāmasamyogamāpa yā ।iti prāsādaśṛṅgeṣu pramadābhirnarottamaḥ ॥2-16-42॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, while riding along the highway overheard the pleasing words uttered by women standing on the elevation of their buildings. Thus hearing his own praise Rama proceeded along the highway.

verses.sloka: शुश्राव राजमार्गस्थः प्रिया वाच उदाहृताः ।स राघवः तत्र कथा प्रलापम् ।शुश्राव लोकस्य समागतस्य ।आत्म अधिकारा विविधाः च वाचः ।प्रहृष्ट रूपस्य पुरे जनस्य ॥२-१६-४३॥
verses.transliteration: śuśrāva rājamārgasthaḥ priyā vāca udāhṛtāḥ ।sa rāghavaḥ tatra kathā pralāpam ।śuśrāva lokasya samāgatasya ।ātma adhikārā vividhāḥ ca vācaḥ ।prahṛṣṭa rūpasya pure janasya ॥2-16-43॥

translations.english: Rama, the best among men, while riding along the highway overheard the pleasing words uttered by women standing on the elevation of their buildings. Thus hearing his own praise Rama proceeded along the highway.

verses.sloka: एष श्रियम् गच्चति राघवो अद्य।राज प्रसादात् विपुलाम् गमिष्यन् ।एते वयम् सर्व समृद्ध कामा।येषाम् अयम् नो भविता प्रशास्ता ॥२-१६-४४॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa śriyam gaccati rāghavo adya।rāja prasādāt vipulām gamiṣyan ।ete vayam sarva samṛddha kāmā।yeṣām ayam no bhavitā praśāstā ॥2-16-44॥

translations.english: Rama heard these various words of admiration by people who had assembled there, and (witnessed) the rejoicings of the citizens.

verses.sloka: लाभो जनस्य अस्य यद् एष सर्वम् ।प्रपत्स्यते राष्ट्रम् इदम् चिराय ।स घोषवद्भिः च हयैः सनागैः ।पुरह्सरैः स्वस्तिक सूत मागधैः ॥२-१६-४५॥
verses.transliteration: lābho janasya asya yad eṣa sarvam ।prapatsyate rāṣṭram idam cirāya ।sa ghoṣavadbhiḥ ca hayaiḥ sanāgaiḥ ।purahsaraiḥ svastika sūta māgadhaiḥ ॥2-16-45॥

translations.english: This scion of the Raghus (Rama) is going to acquire the earth and the wealth today by the king's grace. He will be our protector and fulfil all our desires.

verses.sloka: स घोषवद्भिश्च हयैः सनागैः ।पुरस्सरैः स्वस्तिकसूतमागधैः ।महीयमानः प्रवरैः च वादकैः ।अभिष्टुतः वैश्रवणो यथा ययौ॥२-१६-४६॥
verses.transliteration: sa ghoṣavadbhiśca hayaiḥ sanāgaiḥ ।purassaraiḥ svastikasūtamāgadhaiḥ ।mahīyamānaḥ pravaraiḥ ca vādakaiḥ ।abhiṣṭutaḥ vaiśravaṇo yathā yayau॥2-16-46॥

translations.english: If this Rama obtains the entire kingdom for a long time, it will be in the interest of the people. If he becomes king none will ever witness anything unpleasant or sad. (They observed).

verses.sloka: करेणु मातन्ग रथ अश्व सम्कुलम् ।महा जन ओघैः परिपूर्ण चत्वरम् ।पभूतरत्नम् बहुपण्यसम्चयम् ।ददर्श रामो विमलम् महापथम् ॥२-१६-४७॥
verses.transliteration: kareṇu mātanga ratha aśva samkulam ।mahā jana oghaiḥ paripūrṇa catvaram ।pabhūtaratnam bahupaṇyasamcayam ।dadarśa rāmo vimalam mahāpatham ॥2-16-47॥

translations.english: With bards, panegyrists and great musical performers invoking blessings and walking ahead, he (Rama) proceeded, like Kubera amid intoxicated elephants and horses.
